sections.title: 10th Anniversary
sections.description: The last 10 years have been full of countless memories and epic matches, and we couldn't be more grateful to this amazing community. Whether you've been here since Day 1 or since our most recent Season 1, thank you for playing! To celebrate, from 5/12 - 6/1 you can complete challenges to earn unique Anniversary Lootboxes packed with both new and nostalgic cosmetics - many created by players just like you! On top of that, each challenge you complete contributes to a Global Community Progress Bar. Every week, the community can work together to progress the reward bar past each checkpoint - upgrading that week's reward of a single regular Lootbox to include Epic and Legendary boxes as well! And for those who like going the extra mile, there will be especially tough Prestige challenges to complete, which will net you even more rewards and extra progress toward upgrading the Community reward. We'll also be running a different special Arcade card each week, where you can step into the state of the game as it existed in Overwatch eras past. The cards are as follows: Week 1: Overwatch Classic 2016 Week 2: Mystery Showdown Week 3: Overwatch Classic 2020 We're excited to share the next 10 years and beyond with all of you, and can't wait to celebrate the game's history (and it's future) together. Are you with us?

sections.title: Junkrat's Loot Hunt
sections.description: Junkrat's Loot Hunt is back again, running from June 5-8! Earn lootboxes by completing challenges that unlock as you play!

blocks.title: Progression
blocks.body: All heroes now level up faster.
blocks.dev: Whether you're trying a new hero or aspiring towards Ascended on your favorites, we want to make it faster to earn levels and rewards.

blocks.body: Changed the default setting for "Play Sound When Teammate Eliminated" and "Play Sound When Enemy Eliminated" to "On". Added new keyword "Swap Reloads" to the Advanced Info Panel. Definition: "Fully reloads the hero's weapon after a delay when using another weapon, an alternate mode, or during a Transformation." This keyword has replaced the "Reloads" keyword on all relevant, with the key difference being that these are not instant reloads and have various unique passive reload times that are also now displayed in the line items of the Advanced Info Panel for all relevant abilities. Abilities that instantly reload weapons still use the "Reloads" keyword. Adjusted Post Match Accolades cards to show underrepresented statistics more often and lessen the frequency of overrepresented statistics.

sections.title: Competitive Play Updates
sections.description: Increased requirement to unlock Competitive Play from 20 wins to 50 wins.

changes.text_en: Cooldown is now visible while Nemesis Form is active.
Added a custom UI element showing how many allies are currently being healed by Inspire.
This UI element can be toggled on/off in Brigitte's Hero Options.

blocks.title: Initiator Subrole
blocks.body: No longer triggers while airborne. Now triggers when using a specified movement ability: Winston – Jump Pack D.Va – Boosters Hazard – Violent Lunge Wrecking Ball – Grappling Claw Doomfist – Rocket Punch Heal amount reduced from 60 to 50.
blocks.dev: This change makes the Initiator subrole more deliberate. Rather than activating passively while airborne, tying the trigger to specific movement abilities better integrates the subrole into each hero’s core gameplay loop and gives players more agency over when to access its healing. The healing amount has also been reduced to lower overall effectiveness of the subrole.

heroes.dev_note: This change reduces Micro Missiles’ effectiveness at quickly eliminating lower maximum health targets, lowering D.Va’s assassination potential.

changes.text_en: Impact damage reduced from 3 to 2.

heroes.dev_note: Seismic Slam’s shockwave is now more tightly synchronized with its visual impact, preventing cases where the effect could appear misplaced. This also ensures the camera lock occurs at the moment of impact, rather than triggering early if the camera is adjusted during the slam.

changes.text_en: Camera lock and shockwave effects now trigger later to better align with the animation.
Added new visual and sound effects that play when Empowered Punch is about to time out.

heroes.dev_note: With limited defensive mitigation, Junker Queen struggles to sustain during extended engagements. This adjustment increases the reward for successfully applying Wounds and reinforces her aggressive playstyle.

changes.text_en: (5v5 only) Wound damage self-healing multiplier increased from 2.25x to 2.5x.

heroes.dev_note: Emre’s ability to sustain while applying consistent close‑range pressure was exceeding intended levels. Reducing Siphon Blaster’s healing conversion lowers survivability. Cyber Frag’s minimum radius has also been reduced to require greater precision to get maximum value.

changes.text_en: Healing conversion reduced from 80% to 60%.
Radius of maximum explosion damage reduced from 2 to 1.5 meters.

heroes.dev_note: Reducing Updraft’s cooldown and removing Rising Winds’ height penalty improves Freja’s mobility and positioning. Increasing Bounty Hunting’s Ultimate charge bonus rewards players for securing final blows with more frequent access to Bola Shot.

lines_en: No longer reduces the height gained from Updraft.

changes.text_en: Cooldown reduced from 12 to 10 seconds.
Bonus Ultimate charge increased from 25% to 33%.
Weapon fire volume reduced.

heroes.dev_note: Pharah’s recent damage‑focused perks have improved her kill potential, but their combined consistency has pushed her burst damage too high and are being reduced.

lines_en: Damage reduced per rocket from 40 to 30.

heroes.dev_note: Regenerative Burst’s long cooldown limited its availability during fights. Reducing the cooldown and increasing its healing output allows Baptiste to more reliably support himself and his team during engagements.

changes.text_en: Instant healing increased from 40 to 50.
Healing over time increased from 40 to 50.
Cooldown reduced from 14 to 12 seconds.

heroes.dev_note: While Illari remains a strong offensive support, Solar Rifle’s base projectile size was too large relative to the damage output. Removing the additional base projectile size better aligns the weapon’s accuracy with other hitscan heroes.

changes.text_en: Base projectile size reduced from 0.05 to 0.
Hitscan Global Projectile Size Bonus still applies (0.07).

heroes.dev_note: Protection Suzu offers strong defensive utility across many scenarios. Removing the additional healing on cleanse lowers its burst healing potential.

changes.text_en: Additional healing after negative status cleanse removed (was 30).

heroes.dev_note: Sound Barrier remains one of the most impactful defensive ultimates when timed well. Reducing both its overhealth and duration shortens the mitigation window and places greater emphasis on timing.

changes.text_en: Overhealth granted reduced from 750 to 625.
Duration reduced from 6 to 5 seconds.

heroes.dev_note: Mercy’s Season 2 mobility reduction had an outsized impact on her core gameplay flow. Restoring Guardian Angel’s base functionality reestablishes that feel, while removing Divine Momentum addresses the extreme mobility cases that motivated the original change.

lines_en: Guardian Angel's range is increased by 30%.

changes.text_en: Launch speed increased by 10%. (Reverted to previous value)

heroes.dev_note: Allowing Kekkai Sanctuary to absorb projectiles from both directions improves clarity and creates meaningful interactions when enemies push inside the barrier. Healing and duration have been reduced to offset the additional defensive value.

changes.text_en: Now absorbs enemy projectiles exiting the Sanctuary in addition to enemy projectiles entering the Sanctuary.
Healing over time reduced from 50/s to 40/s.
Duration reduced from 7 to 6 seconds.
Passive self-healing penalty is now correctly at 60% (was 70%).
Fixed an issue where armor's damage reduction was being applied twice to Xuanwu Staff orbs.

blocks.title: General Changes
blocks.body: Increased the timer for a match to end automatically due to a player leaving the match to 3 minutes to cover the Armory timer.

heroes.dev_note: Doomfist has been struggling in Stadium, so we're improving the damage and survivability of some of his core powers and some underutilized options. We're also treating his Passive similarly to many non-scaling Barriers, where they will naturally scale over time from currency.
general: [The Best Defense] now scales proportionally with the Passive Health Gain from Currency.
Overhealth Max Life Scaling increased to 10% (Up from 8%).
Level 3 Punch Bonus Damage increased to 50% (Up from 25%).

heroes.dev_note: To Me, My Friends has been overperforming, granting too much output for how easy to use and consistent it is. We're tuning down the effectiveness to better match its execution burden.
general: Barrier Healing per 1s decreased to 3% of Max Life (Down from 5%).

heroes.dev_note: We're reducing the consistency of Freja's Machine Gun build by requiring her to play closer to her enemies to get full value from her powers.
general: Decreased Currency from Healing and Damage by 5%.
Spread of extra bolts increased by 66%.
Max Life Healing reduced to 4% (Down from 6%).

heroes.dev_note: This is a mini rework designed to give Reaper a more potent anti-air build option, especially with the introduction of the Cat to the roster.
general: Reworked to "[Dire Triggers] deals 30(AP) additional damage over 3s to Airborne enemies and to enemies beyond 8m."
After use an ability or reloading, refresh cooldown of [Dire Triggers].

heroes.dev_note: This interaction of Powers combined with Double Helix has proven to be out of bounds, so we're limiting how much Overhealth this setup grants to be more in line with Soldier: 76's other Power options.
general: Applied reduced effectiveness of Biotic Fields spawned via Hunker Down (50%) to Overhealth.

heroes.dev_note: Vendetta's nerfs in Core have caused her to underperform in Stadium so we're bumping up her currency gain to be more in line with other Damage heroes.
general: Increased Currency gain from Healing and Damage by 5%.

heroes.dev_note: Cat.
general: When [Purr] ends, all other allies within [Purr]'s radius gain Overhealth equal to 40% of damage dealt during [Purr] and 10% to yourself for 3s.
[Purr] persists 15% longer for each ally or enemy currently affected by [Purr], up to 75%. Amount of healing pulses resets every 4 pulses.
Enemies within your [Purr] take damage equal to 30% of its healing.
Ability: [Lifeline] tethers an explosive Toy Ball, that explodes for up to 100 (AP) damage on impact. (6s Cooldown).
When you release a target from [Lifeline] or [Catnapper], restore 20% Fuel. Restore 1% Fuel for every 10 Ability Damage dealt.
Ability: Your next [Quick Melee] deals 40 damage over 3s and increases [Quick Melee] Attack Speed by 100% for 1s (12s Cooldown).
While [Frenetic Flight] is active, [Purr]'s cooldown refreshes 40% faster and all other ability cooldowns refresh 80% faster.
After activating [Frenetic Flight] for 0.5s, next time you collide with an enemy, explode for up 120 damage and restore up to 40% fuel based on distance travelled.
While [Purr] is active, shoot both guns. The bonus shot deals 25% damage.
When hitting an ally with [Biotic Pawjectiles], it bounces to 1 nearby ally within 5m at 25% effectiveness.
+25% Starting Ultimate Charge. [Catnapper] scratches enemies on impact, slowing them and dealing 150 damage over 3s.
[Quick Melee] damage Slows enemies by 10% and Reveals them for 3s.
Recycling Rounds - Epic Weapon Hero Item
While [Purr] is active, restore 20% Max Ammo every 1s.
Tether Speed - Rare Ability Hero Item
When an ally is released from [Lifeline], they gain 30% Move Speed for 3s.
Purr-imeter Expander - Epic Ability Hero Item
Big Boop - Rare Survival Hero Item
[Purr] Knockback Damage slows enemies by 30% for 3s.
Tether Toughness - Epic Survival Hero Item
While [Lifeline] is active, gain 1% Ultimate Charge for every ally tethered and grant 20 Overhealth to them, up to 100, every 1s.
Fuel Pod - Epic Survival Hero Item

heroes.dev_note: The burst damage of Paindrops has been an outlier, so we're shaving off a bit of damage here.
general: Bonus Orb Damage decreased to 30% (Down from 40%).

heroes.dev_note: Zenyatta's survivability has been an outlier among the supports, so we're reducing some of his self healing capabilities.
general: Healing from damage dealt decreased to 20% (Down from 30%).

sections.title: General Item Changes
sections.description: Skyline Nanites - Rare Ability General Item Bonus Damage to Airborne targets increased from 20% to 25%. Aerial Distresser - Epic Weapon General Item Bonus Damage to Airborne targets increased from 25% to 30%. Sundering Vial - Epic Survival General Item Overhealth Reduction internal cooldown reduced from 5s to 3s. Overhealth reduction effect duration increased from 3s to 5s. Necrotic Repellant - Epic Gadget Range increased from 6m to 8m. Colossus Core - Epic Gadget Duration decreased from 5s to 3s. Refresher - Epic Gadget Cost decreased from 13000 to 12000.

sections.title: Website Updates
sections.description: Hero Stats now appear under Heroes → Hero Stats. Hero Ban Rates are now displayed on the PlayOverwatch website in Hero Stats. Hero Pick Rates and Win Rates are still included in Hero Stats. The existing Heroes page has been renamed to Hero Gallery.

blocks.title: General
blocks.body: Fixed an issue where Mizuki’s soft targeting would no longer show while dead. Fixed an issue where Doomfist’s Seismic Slam would sometimes cause a desync issue when landing on the floor. Fixed an issue that incorrectly disabled the Requeue and Leave Game buttons in competitive modes during the post‑match accolades screen. Fixed an issue preventing stick and d‑pad navigation during “While You Wait.” Fixed Vendetta's overhead not getting kill credit when forcing enemies into pits. Fixed Brigitte's VO for Repair Packs being on cooldown not being played under the correct conditions.

blocks.title: Stadium
blocks.body: Fixed an issue where Ramattra's Power Final Form was not properly activating when entering Nemesis Form via Annihilation. Fixed an issue where Ramattra's Item R-7000 Powercell was not properly granting Weapon Power after its max Weapon Power bonus was reached. Fixed an issue where Ramattra's Power Void Blight's damage was not scaling with Weapon Power. Fixed an issue where Barrier Size was not increasing when Ramattra picked both Recursion Relay and Ramparts. Fixed an issue where Ramattra's Void Barrier was not triggering On Ability items. Fixed an issue where combining Swirling Ward and Final Form would cause Ravenous Vortex to heal enemies on Ramattra. Fixed an issue where Cybervenom applies Healing Reduction debuff to allies that are critically healed via Juno's Power MediMaster. Fixed an issue where Mercy's Flash Heal wasn't triggering On Ability Items.
